# Test Data for Deleometer

This folder contains test data for testing the Deleometer plugin.

## Text Files
- `journal_entry.md`: A sample journal entry for testing journal analysis
- `literary_text.md`: A sample literary text for testing text analysis

## Media Files
For complete testing, you'll need to add your own media files:

### Images
Add image files (JPG, PNG, etc.) to this folder for testing image analysis.
Suggested content: artwork, photographs, or other visual content with depth.

### Audio
Add audio files (MP3, WAV, etc.) to this folder for testing audio analysis.
Suggested content: music, spoken word, or field recordings.

### Film/Video
Add video files (MP4, MOV, etc.) to this folder for testing film analysis.
Suggested content: short films, video art, or documentary clips.

## Testing Process
1. Copy these test files to your Obsidian vault
2. Follow the instructions in the TESTING_GUIDE.md file
3. Document any issues or observations during testing
